Pass-through charges as a percentage of Gross Revenue are 14.21% in 2024-25 as against 15.94% in the previous financial year. 3 Spectrum Usage Charges (SUC) yearly increased by 13.02% from Rs.3,369 crore in the year 2023-24 to Rs.3,807 crore in the year 2024- 25 and License Fee also increased by 12.02% from Rs.21,642 crore to Rs.24,242 crore during the same period. 94 4.
